table.name: settle:<time>
table.note: spec-level only (settle delay applies only when id-matched settle tasks exist)

table.name: focus-scroll:true
table.note: HCON key is 'focus-scroll'; htmx reads swapSpec.focusScroll (htmx 4 docs: focusScroll:true)

table.name: focus-scroll:false
table.note: never read; outcome equals config.defaultFocusScroll=false by coincidence

table.name: throttle:<time>
table.note: spec-level

table.name: sse:message
table.note: htmx 2 extension grammar; 4.x hx-sse dispatches htmx:before/after:sse:message + the raw SSE event name

table.name: ws:message
table.note: htmx 2 extension grammar; 4.x hx-ws dispatches htmx:before/after:ws:message

table.name: 23 DOM event names (click … touchmove)
table.note: passed straight to addEventListener

table.name: target containing a space (closest …, find …)
table.note: HCON splits on whitespace → {target:'closest', form:true}; swap lands nowhere, console.warn only

table.name: swap with a modifier (outerHTML show:top) — the modifier
table.note: HCON splits → {swap:'outerHTML', show:'top'}; ctx.show is never read, so the modifier is dropped (swap itself lands)

table.name: credentials (boolean)
table.note: value reaches fetch RequestInit.credentials; a boolean is not a RequestCredentials enum → TypeError, request never sent

table.name: mode
table.note: overwritten after merge: 'mode is security-sensitive, never allow per-element override'

table.name: hx-preserve="false"
table.note: presence selector [hx-preserve]; the string "false" still preserves

table.name: hx-boost="true" via typed API (self or container)
table.note: the required co-emitted hx-<verb> initializes the element first (#shouldInitialize false → never boosted); on a container, 4.x has no implicit inheritance and fluent emits no :inherited

table.name: hx-swap-oob via typed API carries hx-get
table.note: OOB swap lands, but the swapped-in element keeps hx-get and is re-processed as an active trigger (data-htmx-powered)

table.name: :inherited (any attribute)
table.note: not emittable through setHtmx/hx/routes; template writes addAttribute('hx-headers:inherited', …) (projects-template/templates/full-stack/src/core/behaviors/runtime.ts:124)

table.name: handler
table.note: assigned onto ctx by Object.assign; no reader in 4.x (htmx 2 key)

table.name: inlineStyleNonce
table.note: merged onto htmx.config, never read by core (0 `config.inlineStyleNonce` reads)

table.name: detail.xhr.status
table.note: htmx 2 shape; fallback only

table.name: detail.elt / detail.ctx.elt
table.note: 4.x detail = {ctx}; element is ctx.sourceElement; runtime falls back to composedPath (runtime.ts:443)

table.name: detail.ctx.pushUrl / detail.pushUrl
table.note: 4.x key is ctx.push (htmx.js beta6:429); the drawer close-on-pushUrl-nav gate never fires (S13 drawer probe)

table.name: drawer closeOn:nav via pushUrl navigation (non-containing swap)
table.note: drawer stays open + body stays scroll-locked after a pushUrl nav
